title: India to face South Korea in Davis Cup qualifier in Seoul
summary: The Indian Davis Cup team will travel to Seoul to play South Korea in the Qualifier Round 2 for the 2026 Davis Cup. India is currently ranked 19th globally, while South Korea is ranked 16th. The head-to-head record between the two nations in Davis Cup matches is a narrow 6-5 in favour of South Korea. The match will be played on hard courts.
summary_points: India will play South Korea in Seoul for the Davis Cup 2026 Qualifier Round 2.
The match will be contested on hard courts.
India is ranked 19th in the Davis Cup standings.
South Korea is ranked 16th in the Davis Cup standings.
South Korea holds a 6-5 advantage in their head-to-head Davis Cup record against India.

summary_points_hi: भारत डेविस कप 2026 क्वालीफायर राउंड 2 के लिए सियोल में दक्षिण कोरिया से खेलेगा।
